external_prior.paper: Jansen, Swinkels & Zhou (2021), Anomalies in the China A-share market, Pacific-Basin Finance Journal 68, 101607
external_prior.finding: REV 1M long-short paper 2000-2019, equal-weight 1.42% per month t4.35; value-weight 0.80% t1.88; Table 5 value-weight 1-month break-even 0.42% per trade; NOT actual executable long-only net stock return
external_prior.our_difference: Long-only bottom quartile instead of paper long-short deciles; simple 20-joint-trading-session stock price return as past one-month proxy; this study cannot claim exact academic replication

immutable_data.retrieved_data_vintage: 2026-11-10, BaoStock adjusted vendor current history, NOT contemporaneous PIT adjusted corporate-actions
immutable_data.prohibited_data: No V2.8.12 shadow outcomes, Fold3/Fold4, or frozen 2026 Nov02 122/8 forward cohort

design.dates: Exactly already archived 20 first trading-session signals, 2023 Apr-Dec and 2024 Jan-Nov
design.signal_timing: After D closing price known; use adjusted closes for D-20 and D only, 21 continuous joint sessions
design.eligibility: All 21 sessions have valid positive adjusted closes; D status normal and not ST and volume positive; never gate based on D+1 or D+20
design.rank: Ascending simple adjusted D_close / D_minus_20_close - 1; lower past-month return = stronger reversal; tie ascending security_id
design.select: First ceil(25% of D eligible cohort) when at least 40 D eligible; no alternate direction, horizon, rank, or thresholds
design.execution: Entry D+1 adjusted open, exit D+20 adjusted close; no later date substitution; no broker fill confirmed
design.price_source: 2026 BaoStock adjusted history; price-only, not certified economic total return; suspended/limit order may be unfillable
design.primary_metric: Equal-month average of selected mean net 20-session price proxy minus same-month all signal-eligible mean net 20-session price proxy
design.secondary: Selected mean net proxy minus CSI300 same entry and exit price-only, without claiming total return
design.missing_data: Retain original selection identities, note unresolved outcomes and denominator; never reselect and never backfill later session
design.baseline: All eligible stocks on each same signal date, equal weight; same assumed roundtrip cost, no post hoc different matching
